guidetextdraw_609773._value:
INSTRUCTIONS:

Information is required to verify that you do not owe a refund of federal student aid funds. Provide a legible copy of documentation from the National Student Loan Data System (www.nsldsfap.ed.gov) that you have repaid the amount owed or that the federal government updated your record to document you are not required to repay federal student aid funds. We cannot proceed with the review of your financial aid eligibility until you submit a copy of the requested documentation. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.

ACTION: Attach a photocopy of information that the federal student aid was repaid or no longer owed.

Note: If you currently owe back federal student aid funds, submit this form only after you can document that the amount owed was repaid.
